goal: Modularize the Guix build definitions for Linux cross-toolchains into a standalone module.
Enable independent toolchain configurations needed for static-pie release builds and smaller binaries.
agreement: Concept support from hebasto with no stated concerns (hebasto).

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it directly unblocks static-pie release binaries (#25573) and stripped libstdc++ builds (#36193).
Decouples monolithic Guix manifests into reusable toolchain modules for downstream release improvements.

result.summary: Splits Guix cross-compilation toolchain recipes from manifest_build.scm into a dedicated toolchains.scm module and introduces a linux_static.scm manifest. Guix-build is updated to configure GUIX_PACKAGE_PATH and consume the new manifest for Linux builds.
result.problem: Guix Linux toolchain declarations were embedded directly inside the monolithic build manifest, preventing alternative toolchain configurations such as static-pie builds or non-GUI libstdc++ optimizations from being composed cleanly.

reviewability.label: Ready
reviewability.reason: The PR has passing CI, applies cleanly to master, and has no blocking author feedback pending.

agreement.summary: Concept ACK from hebasto with no objections raised.
agreement.reason: hebasto provided a Concept ACK promptly after opening, and no reviewers have raised criticisms.

categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Directly modifies Guix build scripts and manifest definitions under contrib/guix.
categories.rationale: Unblocks static release builds (#25573) and toolchain tuning for binary size (#36193). The author explicitly notes this refactoring is a prerequisite for static builds, representing a major maintainability improvement tied directly to concrete future release binary work.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Touches only Guix build scripts and manifests; the category definition assigns build and release scripts to the build category rather than tools.
categories.rationale: Not a tools change; Guix build scripts and manifests belong to build.

result.card: Splits Guix toolchain definitions out of manifest_build.scm into a separate toolchains.scm module and adds a linux_static.scm manifest. This unblocks producing static-pie release binaries (#25573) as well as stripped-down libstdc++ builds (#36193). The PR is cleanly rebased with passing CI and has received a Concept ACK from hebasto.
